raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "send"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "350 euro"
  role recipient "the user's mother"
  role source "Madrid"
  role destination "Botoșani"
  role instrument "Western Union"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  valid from "2 days ago"

@q query
  select ?d
  where match
    relation "take"
    role subject "a Western Union transfer"
    role object ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end
